correctness.rationale: For λ(t)=r(log(1+t))/(1+t) with continuous positive T-periodic r, s=log(1+t), Z_s=e^{-s}X_{e^s−1}, J_s=S_{e^s−1} yield generator (j−z)∂z+r(s)(f(z,−j)−f(z,j)). Marked Poisson refreshing at intensity 2r(s) realizes the exact flip hazard via Bernoulli 1/2 marks. A two-sided stationary-in-period marked process yields Z*_s=∫_{−∞}^s e^{−(s−u)}J*_u du and exponential coupling (rate min(1,2r*)). This establishes unique phase-periodic laws and all subsequential ballistic weak limits independent of initial direction. Moment equations a′=1−(1+2r)a, v′=2a−2v imply v periodic and bounded strictly between 0 and 1; constant v forces constant a then constant r, proving iff. Harmonic perturbation q_1(s)=−4/k Re[e^{iωs}/((k+iω)(2+iω))] with k=1+2c; numerical independent periodic-ODE solve at c=.9, ε=.003, ω=1.7 differs from linear response by 8.26e−7 (<O(ε²)), showing nonconstant variance. The finite numerical test does not prove attraction or all r.
